outcomes: Use appropriate language to talk about good manners and behavior.
contentSummary: This sub-topic focuses on equipping learners with the ability to use appropriate language to talk about good manners as well as good behavior. To achieve this, learners will identify good table manners, ways of showing kindness and respecting personal space. This knowledge will help learners act responsibly in their daily lives.
teachingMaterials:  Poster showing family having a meal together.
